model.name: gateHarness.invokeFaithfullyOrMarkBroken
model.description: A ci:gate's spawned-tool invocation returns the tool's REAL result (fix stale cwd/parse); a known-broken invocation stays+runs+carries a KNOWN-BROKEN marker naming its task, counted+can-only-shrink, never removed; a gate null is validated against the tool's standalone positive-control.
model.note: owner=expert; architect wires Class(gate-harness spawn)+Method on build-go + re-inspects; planner mints covering task; I mint Tests off tester markers.
